title: [RPG Design Guides] When Convenience Goes Too Far

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】行き過ぎた快適性
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] When Convenience Goes Too Far

blocks.source: 昔、快適性に関しての記事を書いた。
blocks.translation: I once wrote an article about convenience.

blocks.source: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/220111934.html
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/220111934.html

blocks.source: 上の記事のように、筆者は快適性を強く重視すべきと考える。
blocks.translation: As in the article above, I believe convenience should be given strong consideration.

blocks.source: ロード時間や演出が短く、スピーディなゲームは一般的に高く評価されやすい。パラメータ調整や、過剰な演出＆不要な要素のカットだけでも快適性は向上できるため、費用対効果も非常に優れている。
blocks.translation: Games with short loading times and brief, speedy animations generally receive high praise. Convenience can be improved simply by adjusting parameters and cutting excessive animations and unnecessary elements, making this highly cost-effective as well.

blocks.source: しかしながら、快適性にもやりすぎた場合の弊害がある。
blocks.translation: However, taking convenience too far also has drawbacks.

blocks.source: 一般的には、快適性が低いことが問題になるケースが圧倒的に多く、なかなかこの問題にまで行き着くことはない。
blocks.translation: Generally speaking, cases where low convenience becomes a problem are overwhelmingly more common, so people rarely encounter this particular issue.

blocks.source: 実際、１０年以上前に記事を書いた時には、そんな問題はほとんど考えてもみなかった。
blocks.translation: In fact, when I wrote an article more than ten years ago, I hardly even considered such a problem.

blocks.source: ところが、近年は快適性を重視しすぎた結果、問題を起こしている作品を、見かけるようになったので、注意点として挙げてみたい。
blocks.translation: However, in recent years I have started seeing games run into problems as a result of placing too much emphasis on convenience, so I would like to point this out as something to watch out for.

blocks.source: 目次
blocks.translation: Table of Contents

blocks.source: 速すぎる戦闘
blocks.translation: Battles That Are Too Fast

blocks.source: 一般に演出がスピーディな戦闘は好まれる。
blocks.translation: In general, speedy battle animations are well received.

blocks.source: だがそれも、度が過ぎると問題を引き起こす。
blocks.translation: But taking that too far can cause problems.

blocks.source: まず、プレイヤーの脳内処理が戦闘のスピードに追いつかなくなってしまう問題だ。あまりにも速すぎると、何が起こっているのか分からなくなる。
blocks.translation: The first problem is that the player's mental processing can no longer keep up with the speed of battle. If things are too fast, it becomes impossible to tell what is happening.

blocks.source: 結果、プレイもどことなく雑になって、作品が楽しめなくなっていったりする。
blocks.translation: As a result, gameplay can become somewhat careless, making the game less enjoyable.

blocks.source: 気をつけておきたいのは、プレイヤーは作者ほどには作品を理解していないということである。
blocks.translation: One thing to keep in mind is that players do not understand a game as deeply as its creator does.

blocks.source: 作者は作品を深く理解しているため、極端にスピーディな戦闘でも何が起こったかを十分に把握できてしまう。敵が高速で放った効果の複雑なスキルを一瞬で見抜いてしまうというわけだ。
blocks.translation: Because the creator understands the game deeply, they can fully grasp what happened even in extremely speedy battles. They can instantly recognize the effects of a complex skill cast by an enemy at high speed.

blocks.source: あくまで初見のプレイヤーがどう見えるかを意識しよう。序盤からパーティ人数やスキル数が多い作品など、必要な情報が多い場合は特に注意したい。
blocks.translation: Always consider how things look to a player seeing them for the first time. This is especially important in games with a lot of information to process, such as those with many party members or skills from the early stages.

blocks.source: 入力速度と演出速度のギャップ
blocks.translation: The Gap Between Input Speed and Animation Speed

blocks.source: それ以上に深刻で見落とされがちなのは、プレイヤーの入力速度と演出速度のギャップによって引き起こされる問題だ。
blocks.translation: An even more serious and often overlooked problem is caused by the gap between the player's input speed and the animation speed.

blocks.source: 戦闘演出の高速化を極限まで進めていくと、必然的に戦闘においてプレイヤーの入力時間が占める割合が大きくなっていく。
blocks.translation: As battle animations are sped up to the extreme, the proportion of battle time occupied by player input inevitably grows larger.

blocks.source: 一般的に、プレイヤーの入力機会が多いということは、ゲーム性が高いということになるはずだ。それ自体は好ましく感じられるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: Generally speaking, having more opportunities for player input should mean that the game has more depth. That may seem desirable in itself.

blocks.source: だが、これは時にゲーム性に歪みをもたらすことがある。
blocks.translation: However, this can sometimes distort the gameplay.

blocks.source: 具体例
blocks.translation: A Specific Example

blocks.source: オーソドックなターン制の戦闘システムの作品を例にして考えてみよう。
blocks.translation: Let's consider an orthodox turn-based battle system as an example.

blocks.source: この作品の戦闘演出は非常にスピーディで、一つの行動には一秒もかからないとする。
blocks.translation: Suppose the battle animations in this game are extremely speedy, with each action taking less than one second.

blocks.source: 例えば、通常攻撃や同じ技の連打、自動戦闘など入力の手間がかからない手段を使えば、１ターンが５秒で終わるとする。
blocks.translation: For example, suppose a turn takes five seconds if you use options that require little input, such as normal attacks, repeatedly using the same skill, or auto-battle.

blocks.source: 一方でプレイヤーが戦術を練りながら丁寧にコマンドを入力すると、１ターンに２５秒かかるとする。
blocks.translation: On the other hand, suppose it takes 25 seconds per turn when the player carefully inputs commands while devising a strategy.

blocks.source: １ターン辺りの時間差が５倍もあることに注目して欲しい。
blocks.translation: Notice that the difference in time per turn is as much as fivefold.

blocks.source: つまり、プレイヤーが丁寧に操作するよりも、雑に操作したほうが圧倒的に早くなってしまう。
blocks.translation: In other words, playing carelessly becomes overwhelmingly faster than operating the game carefully.

blocks.source: これは意図せずして、プレイヤーに雑なプレイを強く動機づけしてしまう。
blocks.translation: This unintentionally gives players a strong incentive to play carelessly.

blocks.source: 特に……
blocks.translation: In particular…

blocks.source: 通常攻撃が強力
blocks.translation: Normal attacks are powerful

blocks.source: 自動戦闘が強力
blocks.translation: Auto-battle is powerful

blocks.source: リソース管理の要素がゆるい
blocks.translation: Resource management is lenient

blocks.source: ※「戦闘後にＨＰが全快」「ＭＰが存在しない」「回復手段が豊富」など
blocks.translation: ※For example, “HP is fully restored after battle,” “there is no MP,” or “there are abundant ways to recover”

blocks.source: コマンド入力に時間がかかる
blocks.translation: Entering commands takes a long time

blocks.source: ※「パーティ人数が多い」「スキルの数が多い」「システムが複雑」など
blocks.translation: ※For example, “there are many party members,” “there are many skills,” or “the system is complex”

blocks.source: 上記のような作品は要注意だ。
blocks.translation: Games like those described above require particular caution.

blocks.source: 雑魚戦で負けるリスクが低く、下手に戦ってもリソースを消耗しないならば、ボタン連打などで雑に処理したほうが格段に効率がよくなってしまう。
blocks.translation: If the risk of losing random encounters is low and fighting poorly does not consume resources, dealing with them carelessly by mashing buttons will be far more efficient.

blocks.source: 気がついた時には、ただただボタンを押すだけ。ファミコン時代のＲＰＧよりやることがないなんてことも……。
blocks.translation: Before you know it, all you are doing is pressing buttons. You may even have less to do than in an RPG from the NES era…

blocks.source: 演出時間とゲーム性
blocks.translation: Animation Time and Gameplay

blocks.source: 意外かもしれないが、演出時間はゲーム性を大きく左右する。演出時間は決してゲーム性から独立した存在ではない。
blocks.translation: It may be surprising, but animation time has a major impact on gameplay. Animation time is by no means independent of gameplay.

blocks.source: というのも、多くのプレイヤーは時間そのものを判断の基準にするからである。
blocks.translation: This is because many players use time itself as a basis for making decisions.

blocks.source: プレイヤーは誰もが最小ターン勝利や最小被ダメージ勝利を目指しているわけではない。２５秒かけて１ターンで勝利するより、２ターンかかっても１０秒で勝利できるなら、後者を選ぶ人は多いだろう。
blocks.translation: Not every player is aiming to win in the fewest turns or with the least damage taken. Rather than spending 25 seconds to win in one turn, many people would choose to win in 10 seconds even if it takes two turns.

blocks.source: 雑魚戦での経験値稼ぎなら、時短を目指したほうが圧倒的に効率が良いのでなおさらである。結果的に、パーティの成長も早くなるので困ることは少ない。
blocks.translation: This is even more true when grinding EXP in random encounters, since aiming to save time is overwhelmingly more efficient. As a result, the party also grows faster, so there are few drawbacks.

blocks.source: ……というように、速すぎる戦闘は時にゲーム性を崩してしまう。
blocks.translation: …In this way, battles that are too fast can sometimes undermine the gameplay.

blocks.source: 通常なら演出時間がネックとなることで、保たれていた均衡が崩壊してしまっているわけだ。
blocks.translation: The balance that would normally be maintained by animation time acting as a limiting factor has collapsed.

blocks.source: 戦闘演出カット
blocks.translation: Skipping Battle Animations

blocks.source: 戦闘演出カットは便利なシステムである。これがあれば、長い演出に悩まされることもなくなる。
blocks.translation: Skipping battle animations is a convenient system. With it, you no longer have to suffer through lengthy animations.

blocks.source: ……が、快適さと引き換えに味気なさをもたらす。
blocks.translation: …but it brings blandness in exchange for convenience.

blocks.source: 以前、技の演出が非常に長い代わりに、ワンボタンで演出スキップできるゲームをしたことがあるのだが、必然的にほとんどの演出を飛ばすことになった。
blocks.translation: I once played a game where skill animations were extremely long, but could be skipped with the press of a single button. Inevitably, I ended up skipping most of them.

blocks.source: その結果、ただただ表示されるダメージを眺めるだけの味気ない戦闘となってしまった。
blocks.translation: As a result, the battles became bland affairs where all I did was watch the displayed damage numbers.

blocks.source: まるでファミコン時代である。
blocks.translation: It was just like the NES era.

blocks.source: 想像力を働かせる余地がある分、ファミコンのＲＰＧのほうがマシかもしれない。
blocks.translation: NES RPGs might actually be better, since they leave room for the imagination to work.

blocks.source: 現代においては、プレイ動画の見栄えが今一つになるのも無視できない欠点と言えるだろう。
blocks.translation: These days, the fact that gameplay videos look less impressive is also a drawback that cannot be ignored.

blocks.source: 個人的にはそもそもの演出を短めにすれば、演出カットは不要だと思う。やるにしても、奥義などの大技だけ飛ばせるようにするとか。
blocks.translation: Personally, I think that if the animations were kept short in the first place, there would be no need to cut them. If you do include such a feature, it might be better to make only powerful moves such as Arts skippable.

blocks.source: エンカウントなし
blocks.translation: No Encounters

blocks.source: 個人的な経験談。
blocks.translation: This is based on my personal experience.

blocks.source: 昔、作った作品で『エンカウントなし』を実現する装備を中盤～後半の時点で入手できるように設定したのだが、プレイヤーからは「手応えがなくなった」「ダンジョンがむなしい」という不満が上がった。
blocks.translation: In a game I made long ago, I set things up so that equipment enabling “No Encounters” could be obtained around the middle to latter part of the game. However, players complained that “it no longer feels challenging” and “the dungeons feel empty.”

blocks.source: 「だったら使わなければいいじゃん」とこっちは言いたくなるが、人間とは楽なほうに流れるものらしい。
blocks.translation: I wanted to say, “Then just don’t use it,” but apparently people naturally gravitate toward the easier option.

blocks.source: 一応、該当のアイテムは多少入手条件を難しくしていたのだけど、難しいものである。
blocks.translation: I did make the acquisition requirements for the item in question somewhat more difficult, but it seems that wasn’t enough.

blocks.source: 速すぎる移動速度
blocks.translation: Movement Speed That’s Too Fast

blocks.source: 過去、別の記事に書いたので割愛。せっかくなので、リンクを貼っておきます。
blocks.translation: I wrote about this in another article before, so I’ll leave it out here. Since I have the opportunity, I’ll include a link.

blocks.source: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/280090650.html#item5
blocks.translation: https://newrpg.seesaa.net/article/280090650.html#item5

blocks.source: 対策案
blocks.translation: Possible Solutions

blocks.source: 上記の問題の大半は、そもそもが「戦闘が面倒臭い」ということに端を発している。
blocks.translation: Most of the problems mentioned above stem from the fact that battles are tedious in the first place.

blocks.source: よかれと思って、制作者が取った対応が裏目に出てしまっているわけだ。
blocks.translation: In other words, measures taken by creators with the best of intentions have backfired.

blocks.source: 戦闘の快適性を向上させたいなら、まず戦闘回数自体を減らすゲームデザインを検討してみることをオススメしたい。
blocks.translation: If you want to make battles more comfortable, I recommend first considering game design that reduces the number of battles themselves.

blocks.source: エンカウント率を低く、ダンジョンもほどほどの長さにする。戦闘自体もほどほどにスピーディにするが、あくまで常識の範囲内で実装する。
blocks.translation: Keep the encounter rate low and the dungeons a reasonable length. Make the battles themselves reasonably fast-paced as well, but implement this within the bounds of common sense.

blocks.source: こうすれば、一度の戦闘の密度を高められるので、連打ゲーや自動戦闘ゲーにはなりにくい。
blocks.translation: This increases the substance of each individual battle, making it less likely that the game will turn into a button-mashing or auto-battle game.

blocks.source: 自動戦闘については、そもそも採用しないのも選択肢だ。もしくは自動戦闘は通常攻撃限定にするなど機能を限定してもよい。
blocks.translation: As for auto-battle, simply not including it is also an option. Alternatively, you could limit its functionality, such as restricting it to normal attacks.

blocks.source: 他にもリソース管理が厳しく、自動戦闘ではすぐにＭＰが枯渇してしまうようなバランスならこういった問題は起きづらい。
blocks.translation: These problems are also less likely to occur if resource management is strict enough that auto-battle quickly depletes your MP.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: ゲーム性を犠牲にしてまで快適性を極限まで追求してしまうことはオススメできない。行き過ぎると、かえって作業となってしまうからだ。
blocks.translation: I don’t recommend pursuing convenience to the extreme at the expense of gameplay. If you go too far, the game ends up feeling like a chore instead.

blocks.source: 「戦闘は何の操作をしなくても自動で終わります」
blocks.translation: “Battles end automatically without requiring any input.”

blocks.source: 「演出は完全にカットできます」
blocks.translation: “Animations can be skipped completely.”

blocks.source: 「むしろ、戦闘そのものもカットできます」
blocks.translation: “In fact, you can skip the battles themselves, too.”

blocks.source: 最終的にはマップを移動しながら、ひたすらフラグを立て、イベントを鑑賞するだけの作品と化してしまう。
blocks.translation: In the end, the game becomes nothing more than moving around the map, endlessly triggering flags, and watching events.

blocks.source: 果たして、これが面白いかと言われると難しいところだろう。
blocks.translation: Whether that can really be called fun is questionable.

blocks.source: 個人的に疑問に思うのは、雑魚戦を軽視しているのに『数多くの雑魚戦』『長めのダンジョン』『長時間の経験値稼ぎ』といった古典的ＲＰＧの特徴を強く踏襲してしまっているパターンだ。
blocks.translation: What I personally find puzzling is the pattern of heavily adopting classic RPG features such as “numerous battles against weak enemies,” “lengthy dungeons,” and “long hours of grinding for experience,” despite treating battles against weak enemies as unimportant.

blocks.source: そういった古典的ＲＰＧのスタイルは、そもそもが「雑魚戦は楽しいもの」という大前提で設計されている。
blocks.translation: Those classic RPG styles were designed on the fundamental premise that battles against weak enemies are fun.

blocks.source: ※誰に確認したわけでもないけれど、そうでなければ大半のＲＰＧは苦行になるので説明がつきません。
blocks.translation: ※I haven’t confirmed this with anyone, but otherwise, most RPGs would become a form of torture, so it’s the only explanation that makes sense.

blocks.source: そのため、雑魚戦を重視しないなら、古典的ＲＰＧを踏襲する意味もあまりないように思う。
blocks.translation: Therefore, if you don’t consider battles against weak enemies important, I don’t think there is much point in following the conventions of classic RPGs.

blocks.source: 極論を言うと雑魚戦を嫌うなら、もうイベント戦闘だけに限定してしまってもいい。ダンジョンの中身もカットして、一枚絵と立ち絵だけでイベント進行してしまってもいいぐらいじゃないかなと。
blocks.translation: To take this to an extreme, if you dislike battles against weak enemies, you could limit battles to event battles alone. You could even cut out the contents of the dungeons and progress events using nothing but still images and character portraits.

blocks.source: ただし、戦闘が減れば、必然的に他の要素の比重が増えることになる。その『他の要素』に面白みがなければ、やはりその作品はつまらないゲームとなってしまう。
blocks.translation: However, reducing battles inevitably increases the relative importance of the other elements. If those “other elements” aren’t interesting, the game will still end up being boring.

blocks.source: ストーリーやイベント演出に自信があるなら一つの手段ではあるけれど、そうなると「ＡＤＶでよくね？」「アニメでよくね？」といった疑念も湧いてくるのが、また悩ましいところではある。
blocks.translation: If you are confident in your story and event presentation, this is one possible approach. However, in that case, doubts such as “Wouldn’t an adventure game be better?” or “Wouldn’t an anime be better?” may also arise, which makes the decision all the more difficult.

texts.１ターン辺りの時間差が５倍もあることに注目して欲しい。: Notice that the difference in time per turn is as much as fivefold.
texts.つまり、プレイヤーが丁寧に操作するよりも、雑に操作したほうが圧倒的に早くなってし: In other words, playing carelessly becomes overwhelmingly faster than operating the game carefully.
texts.これは意図せずして、プレイヤーに雑なプレイを強く動機づけしてしまう。: This unintentionally gives players a strong incentive to play carelessly.
texts.※「戦闘後にＨＰが全快」「ＭＰが存在しない」「回復手段が豊富」など: ※For example, “HP is fully restored after battle,” “there is no MP,” or “there are abundant ways to recover”
texts.コマンド入力に時間がかかる: Entering commands takes a long time
texts.※「パーティ人数が多い」「スキルの数が多い」「システムが複雑」など: ※For example, “there are many party members,” “there are many skills,” or “the system is complex”
texts.上記のような作品は要注意だ。: Games like those described above require particular caution.
texts.雑魚戦で負けるリスクが低く、下手に戦ってもリソースを消耗しないならば、ボタン連打: If the risk of losing random encounters is low and fighting poorly does not consume resources, dealing with them carelessly by mashing buttons will be far more efficient.
texts.気がついた時には、ただただボタンを押すだけ。ファミコン時代のＲＰＧよりやることが: Before you know it, all you are doing is pressing buttons. You may even have less to do than in an RPG from the NES era…
texts.意外かもしれないが、演出時間はゲーム性を大きく左右する。演出時間は決してゲーム性: It may be surprising, but animation time has a major impact on gameplay. Animation time is by no means independent of gameplay.
texts.というのも、多くのプレイヤーは時間そのものを判断の基準にするからである。: This is because many players use time itself as a basis for making decisions.
texts.プレイヤーは誰もが最小ターン勝利や最小被ダメージ勝利を目指しているわけではない。: Not every player is aiming to win in the fewest turns or with the least damage taken. Rather than spending 25 seconds to win in one turn, many people would choose to win in 10 seconds even if it takes two turns.
texts.雑魚戦での経験値稼ぎなら、時短を目指したほうが圧倒的に効率が良いのでなおさらであ: This is even more true when grinding EXP in random encounters, since aiming to save time is overwhelmingly more efficient. As a result, the party also grows faster, so there are few drawbacks.
texts.……というように、速すぎる戦闘は時にゲーム性を崩してしまう。: …In this way, battles that are too fast can sometimes undermine the gameplay.
texts.通常なら演出時間がネックとなることで、保たれていた均衡が崩壊してしまっているわけ: The balance that would normally be maintained by animation time acting as a limiting factor has collapsed.
texts.戦闘演出カットは便利なシステムである。これがあれば、長い演出に悩まされることもな: Skipping battle animations is a convenient system. With it, you no longer have to suffer through lengthy animations.
texts.……が、快適さと引き換えに味気なさをもたらす。: …but it brings blandness in exchange for convenience.
texts.以前、技の演出が非常に長い代わりに、ワンボタンで演出スキップできるゲームをしたこ: I once played a game where skill animations were extremely long, but could be skipped with the press of a single button. Inevitably, I ended up skipping most of them.
texts.その結果、ただただ表示されるダメージを眺めるだけの味気ない戦闘となってしまった。: As a result, the battles became bland affairs where all I did was watch the displayed damage numbers.
texts.まるでファミコン時代である。: It was just like the NES era.
texts.想像力を働かせる余地がある分、ファミコンのＲＰＧのほうがマシかもしれない。: NES RPGs might actually be better, since they leave room for the imagination to work.
texts.現代においては、プレイ動画の見栄えが今一つになるのも無視できない欠点と言えるだろ: These days, the fact that gameplay videos look less impressive is also a drawback that cannot be ignored.
texts.個人的にはそもそもの演出を短めにすれば、演出カットは不要だと思う。やるにしても、: Personally, I think that if the animations were kept short in the first place, there would be no need to cut them. If you do include such a feature, it might be better to make only powerful moves such as Arts skippable.
texts.個人的な経験談。: This is based on my personal experience.
texts.昔、作った作品で『エンカウントなし』を実現する装備を中盤～後半の時点で入手できる: In a game I made long ago, I set things up so that equipment enabling “No Encounters” could be obtained around the middle to latter part of the game. However, players complained that “it no longer feels challenging” and “the dungeons feel empty.”
texts.「だったら使わなければいいじゃん」とこっちは言いたくなるが、人間とは楽なほうに流: I wanted to say, “Then just don’t use it,” but apparently people naturally gravitate toward the easier option.
texts.一応、該当のアイテムは多少入手条件を難しくしていたのだけど、難しいものである。: I did make the acquisition requirements for the item in question somewhat more difficult, but it seems that wasn’t enough.
texts.過去、別の記事に書いたので割愛。せっかくなので、リンクを貼っておきます。: I wrote about this in another article before, so I’ll leave it out here. Since I have the opportunity, I’ll include a link.
texts.上記の問題の大半は、そもそもが「戦闘が面倒臭い」ということに端を発している。: Most of the problems mentioned above stem from the fact that battles are tedious in the first place.
texts.よかれと思って、制作者が取った対応が裏目に出てしまっているわけだ。: In other words, measures taken by creators with the best of intentions have backfired.
texts.戦闘の快適性を向上させたいなら、まず戦闘回数自体を減らすゲームデザインを検討して: If you want to make battles more comfortable, I recommend first considering game design that reduces the number of battles themselves.
texts.エンカウント率を低く、ダンジョンもほどほどの長さにする。戦闘自体もほどほどにスピ: Keep the encounter rate low and the dungeons a reasonable length. Make the battles themselves reasonably fast-paced as well, but implement this within the bounds of common sense.
texts.こうすれば、一度の戦闘の密度を高められるので、連打ゲーや自動戦闘ゲーにはなりにく: This increases the substance of each individual battle, making it less likely that the game will turn into a button-mashing or auto-battle game.
texts.自動戦闘については、そもそも採用しないのも選択肢だ。もしくは自動戦闘は通常攻撃限: As for auto-battle, simply not including it is also an option. Alternatively, you could limit its functionality, such as restricting it to normal attacks.
texts.他にもリソース管理が厳しく、自動戦闘ではすぐにＭＰが枯渇してしまうようなバランス: These problems are also less likely to occur if resource management is strict enough that auto-battle quickly depletes your MP.
texts.ゲーム性を犠牲にしてまで快適性を極限まで追求してしまうことはオススメできない。行: I don’t recommend pursuing convenience to the extreme at the expense of gameplay. If you go too far, the game ends up feeling like a chore instead.
texts.「戦闘は何の操作をしなくても自動で終わります」: “Battles end automatically without requiring any input.”
texts.「むしろ、戦闘そのものもカットできます」: “In fact, you can skip the battles themselves, too.”
texts.最終的にはマップを移動しながら、ひたすらフラグを立て、イベントを鑑賞するだけの作: In the end, the game becomes nothing more than moving around the map, endlessly triggering flags, and watching events.
texts.果たして、これが面白いかと言われると難しいところだろう。: Whether that can really be called fun is questionable.
texts.個人的に疑問に思うのは、雑魚戦を軽視しているのに『数多くの雑魚戦』『長めのダンジ: What I personally find puzzling is the pattern of heavily adopting classic RPG features such as “numerous battles against weak enemies,” “lengthy dungeons,” and “long hours of grinding for experience,” despite treating battles against weak enemies as unimportant.
texts.そういった古典的ＲＰＧのスタイルは、そもそもが「雑魚戦は楽しいもの」という大前提: Those classic RPG styles were designed on the fundamental premise that battles against weak enemies are fun.
texts.※誰に確認したわけでもないけれど、そうでなければ大半のＲＰＧは苦行になるので説明: ※I haven’t confirmed this with anyone, but otherwise, most RPGs would become a form of torture, so it’s the only explanation that makes sense.
texts.そのため、雑魚戦を重視しないなら、古典的ＲＰＧを踏襲する意味もあまりないように思: Therefore, if you don’t consider battles against weak enemies important, I don’t think there is much point in following the conventions of classic RPGs.
texts.極論を言うと雑魚戦を嫌うなら、もうイベント戦闘だけに限定してしまってもいい。ダン: To take this to an extreme, if you dislike battles against weak enemies, you could limit battles to event battles alone. You could even cut out the contents of the dungeons and progress events using nothing but still images and character portraits.
texts.ただし、戦闘が減れば、必然的に他の要素の比重が増えることになる。その『他の要素』: However, reducing battles inevitably increases the relative importance of the other elements. If those “other elements” aren’t interesting, the game will still end up being boring.
texts.ストーリーやイベント演出に自信があるなら一つの手段ではあるけれど、そうなると「Ａ: If you are confident in your story and event presentation, this is one possible approach. However, in that case, doubts such as “Wouldn’t an adventure game be better?” or “Wouldn’t an anime be better?” may also arise, which makes the decision all the more difficult.
